name: Namo Hanumate Tubhyam
text:
Namo Hanumate Tubhyam,
Namo Maruta Sunave,
Namah Sri Rama Bhaktaya,
Shyamashya cha tey Namaha.
meaning: Salutations to you, Hanuman; salutations to the son of the Wind; salutations to the devotee of Sri Rama; and salutations to you who belong to Shyama, the dark Mother, Kali.
note: This mantra joins Hanuman and Kali (Shyama), which is why it is not found in published collections. Kept exactly as Sarvakali gives it.
source: Sarvakali’s teaching (her guru’s version); not a published text
pronunciation: na-mo ha-nu-ma-tay tub-hyam; na-mo maa-ru-ta soo-na-vay; na-mah shree raa-ma bhak-taa-ya; shyaa-maa-shya cha tay na-ma-ha
